description: This file defines a REST controller named TransactionController that handles HTTP POST requests for fund transfers and utility payments in a financial application. It delegates the actual transaction operations to a TransactionService.

classes.name: TransactionController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller class that provides endpoints for performing financial transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to initiate a fund transfer. Logs the action and delegates to the TransactionService.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests for utility payments. Logs the action and delegates to the TransactionService.
